changeSet.sql: create or alter function graph.GetBackwardLineage ( @currentHop int, @endHop int, @assetIds dbo.Ids readonly, @intersectIds dbo.Ids readonly ) RETURNS TABLE AS RETURN ( with b as ( select I.IntersectID, I.PredicateID, I.PredicateUid, I.PredicateName, I.PredicateType, @currentHop-1 as SubjectHop, S.ID as SubjectID, @currentHop as ObjectHop, O.ID as ObjectID from @assetIds H inner join Asset O on O.ID = H.ID inner join PredicateIntersect I on I.Object = O.Object and I.ObjectID = O.ObjectID and I.PredicateType in (1, 12, 13) and I.IntersectID not in (select Id from @intersectIds) inner join Asset S on S.Object = I.Subject and S.ObjectID = I.SubjectID union all select I.IntersectID, I.PredicateID, I.PredicateUid, I.PredicateName, I.PredicateType, b.SubjectHop-1 as SubjectHop, S.ID as SubjectID, b.SubjectHop as ObjectHop, O.ID as ObjectID from b inner join Asset O on O.ID = b.SubjectID and b.SubjectHop >= @endHop inner join PredicateIntersect I on I.Object = O.Object and I.ObjectID = O.ObjectID and I.PredicateType in (1, 12, 13) and I.IntersectID <> b.IntersectID and I.IntersectID not in (select Id from @intersectIds) inner join Asset S on S.Object = I.Subject and S.ObjectID = I.SubjectID ) select * from b )
